parameters.name: 004 LTTP - Time of the Falling Rain

parameters: She’s gone! I can’t find her anywhere! \n<Erynn> \autoevent[0]
Stay calm. We’ll send out a search at once. \n<Guard Captain> \autoevent[28]
We’ll search together. Don’t worry. \n<Guard Friend> \autoevent[29]
The guards gather, weary. To deliver the bad news...
We’ve found no trace. She may have wandered beyond the village.\!
It’s too dangerous out there\..\..\.. we can’t risk more lives tonight. \n<Guard Captain> \autoevent[28]
Erynn clenches his fists, anger and fear mixing.
You can’t just stop! She’s still out there!
How can you give up so easily!? \n<Erynn> \autoevent[0]
I'm truly sorry, but that's all we can do for now... \n<Guard Captain> \autoevent[28]
If \c[3]Link\c[0] were here, maybe he would be able to help you\|,
but unfortunately, he's out doing his endeavors\..\..\.. \n<Guard Captain> \autoevent[28]
And we have no idea when he's going to be back. \n<Guard 1> \autoevent[30]
Yeah, unfortunately, we haven't seen him in days\..\..\.. \n<Guard 2> \autoevent[31]
I am deeply sorry. However, if you would excuse us so kindly, we have
some other matters to attend to\..\..\.. \n<Guard Captain> \autoevent[28]
I know how much this means to you\..\..\.. but outside the walls, monsters roam.
If you leave, you may never return. \n<Guard Friend> \autoevent[29]
After a long pause, the guard sighs, placing a hand on his shoulder.
If you truly won’t be stopped\..\..\.. then at least take these. \n<Guard Friend> \autoevent[29]
He presses a small pouch of \i[2274]\c[3]Rupees\c[0] into the Erynn’s hands, along with
It’s not much, but it might keep you safe.\!
\c[6]Find her\..\..\..\|\c[0] and come back alive! \n<Guard Friend> \autoevent[29]
I'm not sure how far I'll get with these, but I'll sure try.\!
No!\! I have to try, I have to find her, no matter what! \n<Erynn> \autoevent[0]
That's the spirit!\| As long as you're hopeful, you will prevail, no matter what!\!
Now, if you \c[6]need anything from me, I'll be near your house\c[0] in case she comes back. \n<Guard Friend> \autoevent[29]
Also, try to go to the \c[6]Hall of Vision\c[0].
Maybe the lady there can help you. \n<Guard Friend> \autoevent[29]
Thus begins the journey of one ordinary villager\..\..\.. Eyrnn.\|
Whose search for their loved one may uncover echoes far greater than they ever imagined.
